name: EPIC 210712441
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 10.6 solar radii and 1.21 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 1,422 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 1.21 solar masses and 10.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,884 K at its surface.
